hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/bin/ruff"; [ -x "$R" ] || R=ruff; case "$f" in *.py) "$R" format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; "$R" check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.css) (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1);; esac; exit 0

c="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_command"; case "$c" in *"push --force"*|*"push -f "*) echo 'refused: force push' >&2; exit 2;; *"--no-verify"*) echo 'refused: --no-verify bypasses the gates in docs/AI_CODE_QUALITY.md' >&2; exit 2;; *"pip install"*) case "$c" in *"--require-hashes"*) exit 0;; *) echo 'refused: install from the hashed lock only' >&2; exit 2;; esac;; *printenv*|*'$OPENROUTER'*) echo 'refused: credentials are read by the process, never printed (docs/DECISIONS.md 16)' >&2; exit 2;; *".env"*) case "$c" in *".env.example"*) exit 0;; *) echo 'refused: .env is read by the process, never by a command (docs/DECISIONS.md 16)' >&2; exit 2;; esac;; esac; exit 0
